subject: Coffee and the back fence
text: Hi, I know this is last minute, but if you have an hour this Saturday, I was hoping you might stop by for a coffee and see if the back fence project is actually moving or still just pretending to be finished. I keep meaning to sand the last two boards, yet the afternoon always disappears into shopping lists and phone calls, and the glue is probably still stuck to my kitchen counter. I do not need help unless you want it, but company would keep me honest, and I can promise snacks. If you are busy, no problem, maybe next week after we water the garden. Please just text when you think is realistic. I am not trying to trap you into a whole weekend of errands, only this stubborn corner that has been staring at me since the first warm week. Bring any sunglasses you can spare, because the porch light is still too harsh for daytime work. If your calendar is already overloaded, say so plainly, and I will not take it personally. There is always Sunday morning, even if it is cold and the coffee tastes burnt. I can bring the extension cord if you drive.
